verbs.name: render.bundle
verbs.description: Render ONE timeline window into a publish package per platform (social repurposing capstone). Reframes via render_range with the platform aspect geometry + fit:cover, normalizes loudness (default -14 LUFS, social), and emits per platform: hashed mp4 + hashed windowed captions (srt+vtt) + a hashed thumbnail + an OUTPUT-fact receipt. returns {job_id, bundle_id}; the package payload lands in the job result. Package status is ready only when every platform receipt passes, required writes/hashes succeed, optional thumbnails exist, and brand constraints pass. The saved project.brand kit is enforced automatically; brand_ref is an explicit one-call override. An atomic exports/<bundle_id>/manifest.json binds deliverables, hashes, source op, QC, and the brand source/result. Default platforms 9:16 + 1:1 + 16:9. `candidate:{at_ms,dur_ms}` is a TIMELINE window. Output FENCED.

range_ms.description: Timeline window [start, end) to bundle. Omit with `candidate` or to bundle the whole timeline.

candidate.description: A timeline window as {at_ms, dur_ms} (e.g. a clip.candidates pick mapped to the timeline).

platforms.description: Aspect ratios to render, e.g. ["9:16","1:1","16:9"] (default). Each is W:H with small integers.

normalize_loudness.description: Target integrated LUFS for every clip (default -14, social).

brand_ref.description: Optional validated one-call brand override. Omit to enforce the saved project.brand kit when present.

verbs.result: {job_id, bundle_id} — package lands in jobs.status.result: {bundle_id,range_ms,status:ready|needs_review|blocked,pass,issues:[{code,severity,aspect?,detail}],warnings:[...],platforms:[{aspect,width,height,path,hash,caption_path,caption_hash,vtt_path,vtt_hash,caption_count,thumb,thumb_hash,receipt_id,pass,duration_ms}],receipt_ids,brand?,manifest_path,manifest_hash}. Non-ready packages finish as done_with_warnings because artifacts are usable but issues require review.

verbs.name: render.queue
verbs.description: BATCH DELIVERY — a sequential render queue. Fan the ONE current timeline out into N renders, each with its own delivery settings, every one running through the SAME render.final path (job + segmented OOM-bounded encode + auto verify.checks -> RenderReceipt). PURE DELIVERY ORCHESTRATOR (autopilot.run/recipe.run mould): records NO op of its own and makes NO timeline mutation, only dispatches render.final per entry and reuses the job infra; NO checkpoint (nothing to revert). SEQUENTIAL, not concurrent (deliberate): render is memory-heavy and render.final already bounds peak RSS WITHIN one render (adaptive segmentation + a Linux cgroup soft-limit); N renders at once would multiply peak memory by N and defeat that. The next render starts only after the prior reaches a terminal state. Entries are INDEPENDENT deliveries: a failed one is recorded and the queue CONTINUES (never aborts the batch). Each entry is a render.final arg SUBSET (with `output` accepted as the alias for render.final's `path`), VALIDATED UP FRONT by a render.final dry_run per entry — a bad entry fails the WHOLE queue before any encode, naming the offending index. returns {queue_id, count, jobs:[{idx, output}]}; the per-entry job_ids + receipts fill into the queue job result (jobs.status{job_id: queue_id}) as each render completes. Requires an open project.

jobs.description: The deliveries to render, in order. Each entry is a render.final arg SUBSET; the render.final dispatch is the authoritative validator (unknown keys / bad enums are rejected per entry, up front, via a dry_run).

items.description: A render.final arg-set for one delivery. `output` aliases render.final's `path` (the file to write, FENCED per ). Other keys mirror render.final: preset, format, hardware, bitrate, target_size_mb, rate_control, audio_bitrate, profile, fit, resolution, aspect, width, height, normalize_loudness.

output.description: Output file path for this delivery (alias for render.final's `path`). FENCED. Omit to use the default <project>/exports/<render_id>.<ext>.

path.description: Output file path (render.final's native key). Pass `output` OR `path`, not both.

expected_origin_path_sha256.description: Optional canonical project origin digest from project.state.project_identity; a changed project conflicts before dry-run or queue admission.

verbs.result: {queue_id, count, jobs:[{idx, output}]} — sequential batch delivery; the queue job result (jobs.status{job_id: queue_id}) fills in per-entry {idx, job_id, render_id, output, ok, pass, receipt, error?} as each render.final completes, plus {summary_line, count, succeeded, failed}.

x-async-result.const: {summary_line, count, succeeded, failed, jobs:[{idx, job_id, render_id, output, ok, pass, receipt, error?}]} via jobs.status{job_id: queue_id}
